search.query: | mstats avg("psi.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("psi.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("psi_cpu_some_avg10","psi_cpu_full_avg10","psi_cpu_some_avg60","psi_cpu_full_avg60") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("psi.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("psi_mem_some_avg10","psi_mem_full_avg10") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("psi.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("psi_io_some_avg10","psi_io_full_avg10") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
